name: The Skarl Tally-Board
description: A copy of the tally-board by the Skarl Delving's mouth, rubbed onto oiled paper by some earlier traveller and left pinned under a stone.

name: Corra Bracken's Count
description: A strip of birch bark from the Tallying Hide's post: a woodfolk hunter's key to her own count of the harts carried to the Horn Pale.

name: The Listeners' Log, the Last Leaf
description: The last leaf of the Circle's Listeners' log, left under a horn at their camp in 1038 and never collected.

name: How the Thorn Is Laid
description: The thorn-layers' rule of their work, copied off the lintel of the Layers' Ring by a forester who wanted to know why nobody volunteers for it.

name: On Unstringing
description: A bowyer's note on the Woodfolk custom of unstringing a dead hunter's bow, from the door of the house at Stave Hollow.

name: The Beacon Rule
description: A strip of birch-bark cut from the pole of the Northwold Beacon, the Woodfolk's rule for its fires burnt into it with a hot nail.

name: A Moss for Davy
description: A charcoal-burner's list of the mosses on her son's grave, written small on the back of a tally-stick; the grave has no one in it.

name: The Measure of the Runner
description: The Rookhold keepers' knotted measure of the Stray Thorn, a runner of the Briar that grows the wrong way.

name: The First Tines
description: The forecourt roll of the Tine Barrow: the first Hart-Knights, each named for the hart they would not kill.

name: Countwatch Chalk
description: A forester's slate with the morning count of the grey patches on the Briar, as it stood when the count first went down.

name: The Hanging Words
description: A thong of plaited hide knotted with the words the Woodfolk say when a dead hunter's bow is hung on Hollin Tor, one knot a word.

name: The Northern Keepers' Rule
description: The rule of the northern gate's keepers, who carried every fallen stone up Harrow Tor until the Chain Years.

name: What the Grey Man Hears
description: A forester's note, folded into a square the size of a thumb, of what she heard from the top of the Grey Man over three nights.

name: The Chapel's Count
description: A Hart-Knight's count of the antlers taken from the Antler Chapel, and a request.

name: Out of the Mere, Dry
description: A letter from Ormhold about the child who fell into Blackgill and came up in the Mere, dry.

name: Measuring the Hart
description: A Sayer's measuring-book, its last page taken up with the Hart Bones and ending halfway down a column, the pencil still in the fold.

name: A Poacher's Reckoning
description: A poacher's reckoning of his season's harts, and what the Horn Pale paid for them.

name: The Clamps' Day-Book
description: The Charcoal Camp's day-book, in which the two burners who never sleep at once have their only conversation.

name: The Verderer's Fires
description: The count kept by the verderer on the top deck of his tower, of the fires he has seen, and of one he cannot explain.

name: Marks in the Face
description: A Tollmere mason's rubbing of the Builders' marks in the Old Quarry's face, and what it proves about the Long Stride.

name: Three Days Kneeling
description: A Hart-Knight's slate at the Moot Gate Stone, written on the third day of his vigil.

name: What the Skarl Owe
description: A Skarl exile's account of the death at the delving, written on the inside of a split goatskin and pushed into the secret room's wall.

name: The Builders' Hand
description: The pattern the antler-boilers burn into every tine they sell as Oroth antler, and a boiler's note on where it came from.

name: The Pale's Rules
description: The Horn Pale's rules, nailed inside its gate by the factor who wrote the price book.

name: Grey Inside the Wold
description: A Fernhold forester's slate at the Greyed Ring: the first word of a grey patch inside the Wold.

name: The Boilers' Account Book
description: The antler-boilers' account book: what the Horn Pale pays for a hart's antlers, and what Tollmere sells them for.

name: The Factor's Price Book
description: The Tallymen's factor's price book from the Horn Pale, with the margin on every tine of Oroth antler written plain.

name: A Grey Sallow Stem
description: A withy cut from the Greyed Ring. It is grey right through, pith and all, and it does not bend: it is not dry, and it is not dead, and it is as heavy as a green one. Held up in the light it throws no colour on the hand under it.

name: Davy Colley's Whistle
description: A hazel whistle whittled by a boy, the bark left on for the grip, wrapped round in weaver silk so thick it took a knife to find it. It still plays. It plays one note, and not well, and a burner under the Skarl tor would know it anywhere.

name: Hal Rooke's Felling Axe
description: A burner's felling axe, the haft worn black where two hands held it for forty years, the head notched with the Rookes' mark. Fine roots have grown through the eye of it and round the haft, as if the axe had been planted.

name: The Brother's Heartwood
description: A knot of heartwood as long as a forearm, out of the Old Root where it stood up, dark as tea and heavy as iron. It smells of the Hollow's walls. Cille Tamwood, who oils the Grandfather, would know the smell anywhere.

name: Ardo's Tines
description: The antlers of the white hart that Ardo, the first of the Hart-Knights, would not kill, and wore when it died old: fourteen points, gone the yellow of old ivory, the brow tines worn smooth by four hundred years of hands. Fixed to a band of blackened iron that was made for a smaller head than the last one that wore it.

name: The Bells' Vigil
description: A board of the Mourners' vigil hours, nailed under the oak's lowest root.

name: The Moss Names
description: A tender's list, rolled in birch bark and tucked into the seed-bed.

name: Pellow's Game-Book
description: The parker's game-book, its last pages, swollen with damp.

name: The Strippers' Tally
description: A strippers' tally, chalked on a slab of bark.

name: The Lee's Rule
description: A poachers' rule, scratched on a slate by the bow-rack.

name: The Last Watch
description: The firewatch's log, its last page, still in the fallen stair.

name: The Pickers' Rule
description: A pickers' rule, cut on a shingle hung by the fall.

name: What the Sentinels Hear
description: A child's slate left at the foot of the middle stone.

name: The Charter Delf's Ledger
description: The Charter Company's ledger for the Delf, 1029 to 1036, every tub weighed and written down in Silas Penhallow's small hand, and at the back the surveyor's soundings of the deep gallery: eighty fathoms, granite, granite, granite, and then a word underlined three times. Thorn.

name: The Brake-Dam's Collar
description: Not a collar: a ring of the Briar's thorn the Brake-Dam's neck grew through, cut free, still green on the inside. The Layers would know what it is. They would not want it in the house.
